proposed.reason: §7 fixes the domain and names the SignedTerms fields; the member names, types and the ShieldedSource / ShieldedDestination / ShieldedCorridor nesting above are a proposal.
Added per Riddler#1296 (2026-10-17): rail a_tracer | b_panel, so a digest for one rail cannot settle on the other; feePayer is the public Aztec fee payer (PrivateFPC in production).

intent_id, quote_id, operation_id, source_authorization_digest and reservation_id are not members: a preview must return a stable digest with no authorization or reservation. The execute-time struct binds termsDigest to them and is a later version.
Not a member: §7 lists its typed shape as open. The exact source and destination amounts are bound.

proposed.item: assetId, recipientBindingId as strings; policyRevision as uint32

proposed.reason: §7 defines only design A's profile. The rail-b-panel vector changes rail alone; the b_panel profile and its pairing rule are open.

The EIP-712 digest of the §7 RecipientBinding whose shared members (source wallet/chain, aztecRecipient, aztecToken, descriptorDigest, corridor) are the terms' own; only nonce and challengeExpiry come from the binding. Each vector carries that binding.
